Cada cuántos minutos se comprueba que el: How many minutes between checks that the graph and the AI models respond. It is a cheap ping: a request of a few tokens per model, or its models list on an endpoint without a key such as Ollama. The full check, the same request ingestion makes (about 2,000 tokens), runs when an engine is tested, added or edited, in the setup wizard, when the engine in use changes and once a day; its result is shown beside each engine in Administration. 0 = do not check (nor the daily check).
El decisor responde, pero no con una let: The decider answers, but not with a letter of the options and its logprobs
El motor LLM, de embeddings o decisor po: The default LLM, embedding or decider engine does not answer the periodic check, or answers but fails the full check (the structured output ingestion needs, or the decider's letter with logprobs), which runs when the engine in use changes and once a day
